_comment: SPARC branding and the join CTA. Edit this, re-run build/build_page.py, done. build/verify.py fails while cta_url is still empty, so the page cannot ship with a dead Join button.
_site_comment: Where the dashboard lives. The share cards print it so a card can deliver on its own promise: someone who sees one course can reach the other 27.
_brand_comment: Colours sampled from assets/sparc-logo.png, not guessed: navy #151049, pink #ee0451. accent_bar is the only colour on the page and appears only inside data bars; it must clear 3:1 against #fcfcfb. It is a lighter step of the logo navy (same hue, 245) so bars read as accent rather than ink. The logo pink is NOT used as a second data colour - it fails 4.5:1 as text (4.29:1) and red on a would-take-again bar reads as a verdict the data has not made.
